name: Ludan-tech Ltd.
summary: Ludan-tech Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Ludan Engineering Co. Ltd, a leading multidisciplinary engineering firm based in Israel. The company comprises several specialized divisions, such as Ludan Software and Control Systems LTD (located in Israel) and Ludan System Solutions SRL (located in Romania). These divisions focus on the complete lifecycle of computerized systems and industrial process controls, encompassing their design, integration, installation, and final execution. Furthermore, Symcotech, another division within Ludan-tech, specializes in the development and production of Ticket Vending Machines (TVMs) and Automated Test Equipment.
